behavior: Replace empty wide-case mapping stubs with typed single-scalar Unicode case maps. Rust char literals guarantee valid scalar keys and values; safe binary search preserves unmapped characters. ASCII uses standard ASCII scalar mapping. No host libc or full string case expansion is involved.

Ri18n_towupper/towlower are now total safe functions: invalid/negative/surrogate/out-of-range integer values remain unchanged. Remove the empty C-style tables, unused pair layout and handwritten integer search.

Generate data reproducibly from exact selected upstream R headers with source commit, labelled upstream Unicode version and each header SHA256 in the generated file. Generator rejects mismatched versions, non-scalars, duplicate keys and unsorted maps. No upstream C code is compiled.

upstream.runtime_oracle: Existing local GNU R bac583 r90451 Darwin oracle, UTF8 child locale; reference scalar examples include Éßᾈ, iσß and Deseret. Do not conflate local Darwin iconv behavior with Linux.

validation.wasm: r-wasm release check, original panic-unwind build-std/max-memory256MiB profile PASS; no new browser execution claim

limitations: Replacement-mode implementation/tests are subsequent uncommitted rport-w03x.6 work and excluded from this data milestone. Public toupper/tolower builtin string handling, native-byte profiles and locale-specific tailoring remain separate scope.
User graphics edits and parent replacement work were present during validation and excluded. No immutable whole-CI, all-Unicode/locale or full-PCRE2 claim.
Generated mapping version describes the selected upstream data; no claim about the release date of a Unicode standard.
